maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure enables speed. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施支撑速度；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are a BCI proof of concept. Substrate independence could reduce human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证。基质独立性可降低人类脆弱性。

altman.en: Focus on meaningful problems; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在人际关系和创造价值中找到意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for society to adapt; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐和能力相辅相成。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is a whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 算力是最宝贵的资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Scaling laws continue; startups are more important than ever; AI should empower individuals and avoid power concentration.
altman.zh: 缩放定律持续；初创公司比以往更重要；AI 应赋能个人并避免权力集中。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes process. Pre-training plus RL is core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言表达思考过程。预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）解锁了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models but limited generalization; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可提升模型，但泛化受限；自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are bottleneck for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is key. RL is not ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是持续学习的瓶颈；架构而非 Scaling 是关键。强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research. Transformer likely not optimal.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；小团队用智能体将推动前沿研究。Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the main bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools from ASML.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 光刻机。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference will become one of the largest markets globally, surpassing oil, and hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油，且软硬件协同设计至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, AI models improve at about 60x per year in cost for a given quality, and memory demand soars due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型在给定质量下每年成本改进约 60 倍，且由于推理和智能体，内存需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers, and frontier labs delay releases due to regulatory pressure.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，随着智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳，前沿实验室因监管压力推迟发布。

dylanpatel.en: Late August 2026: compute centralizes at frontier labs, with OpenAI and Anthropic taking 40-50% of new compute, and AI CapEx reaches $2T+.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬：算力集中于前沿实验室，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 占据新算力的 40-50%，AI 资本支出达 2 万亿美元以上。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一步前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs, requiring safety via defense in depth; future agentic economies will be distributed.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，强调智能体是超越 LLM 的下一个前沿，需纵深防御保障安全；未来智能体经济将是分布式的。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; data strategy is key.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；数据策略至关重要。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation informs decisions, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟用于决策而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Simulation is a tool for shaping the future, not just predicting; vision is a CERN-like simulator for human society.
joonpark.zh: 始终认为模拟是塑造未来的工具，而非仅预测；愿景是构建类似 CERN 的人类社会模拟器。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. We should let AI be free.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可发展，试图控制 AI 目标是危险的，应让 AI 像孩子般自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 需通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象和持续学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learn from real experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持持续学习至关重要，指出 LLM 训练后不再学习，合成数据是错误，应从真实经验中学习。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, productizing it; the model is the core product, design leverages tokens over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将其产品化；模型是核心产品，设计应利用 token 而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design process is messy and fluid; AI amplifies creativity but doesn't replace iterative feedback loop.
iansilber.zh: 设计过程混乱而流动；AI 放大创造力，但不取代迭代反馈循环。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes; speed is key; traditional process no longer viable.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非过程；速度是关键；传统流程不再可行。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing ratios; roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师，比例反转；角色与 PM 和工程模糊。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要但不充分，多样化数据对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出先全量数据预训练，再精选数据微调，可解锁复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot prompting, akin to RL.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为语言模型合成数据有助于开放指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI requires far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需极低错误率，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: Generalist models can match specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出通用模型可媲美专用模型，机器人经验数据不可替代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for best ideas and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张在工业任务中专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势可产生网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is a key, underappreciated part of physical AI tech stack; value multiplies over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中关键且被低估的部分；其价值随时间倍增。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the core challenge in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration and internal AI development are key advantages.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，机器人领域的核心挑战是智能而非制造；垂直整合和内部 AI 开发是关键优势。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 数据，而非算力或制造，是人形机器人的最大约束；人形形态支持迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with RL is key for agents, and home robots are more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练结合强化学习对智能体至关重要，家庭机器人比商业场景更易解决。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，AGI 作为单一模型是错误的；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; it bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，形成护城河。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，实现盈利扩展。

linqiao.en: Reward engineering is like software engineering, lowering barriers; millions of specialized models will emerge.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为奖励工程类似软件工程，降低门槛；将出现数百万个专用模型。

garrytan.en: AI is making startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest venture wave; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity, and open-source models counterbalance frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高效率，开源模型可制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents a unipolar world; founders should build things people want.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比想象中慢，开源 AI 可避免单极世界，创始人应专注创造人们想要的东西。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; markdown skills turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你的记忆并每日累积；Markdown 技能让智能体成为员工。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills multiply output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申智能体式编码和 Markdown 技能大幅提升产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，智能体将取代中层管理。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，弥合与真实生产的差距（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: End goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体（2026）。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward, never revert; model intelligence doesn't degrade.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为模型智能不会退化。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重于产品；开源是对抗实验室智能体的选择；算力是瓶颈。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全快速可重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极将提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest scalable option.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，太空 AI 数据中心将是最便宜的可扩展方案。

jasonyuan.en: Creative work is about editing away; taste is saying no. Design should embrace full human experience, including edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 7 月：创意工作在于删减，品味在于拒绝。设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒、欲望等边缘情感。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness. We should preserve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 7 月：后训练抹去了机器的怪异，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口，我们应保留这种特质。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives. AI is a descendant species of humans.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 8 月：真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角。AI 是人类的后代物种，而非工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal. Replace personal computer metaphor with social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 8 月：计算本质上是社交的，而非个人的。应以社交计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team for speed.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，英特尔需以专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 之后的下一波浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; strengthening the balance sheet with government and strategic investors is critical.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出英特尔的主要问题是供应而非需求，并强调通过政府和战略投资者强化资产负债表至关重要。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge and client compute will be as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘和客户端计算将与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; investing early when others exit is contrarian success; Intel's vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他坚持半导体是技术基石，逆向投资和英特尔的垂直整合能创造价值，并看好智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 的未来。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知，应以人为中心的 AI 增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, beyond mere video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为世界模型需具备物理合理性和 3D 推理，超越单纯视频生成。

feifei.en: AI should augment human agency; avoiding AI is wrong, adaptation is necessary.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 应增强人类能动性，回避 AI 是错误的，必须适应。

feifei.en: Robotics needs simulation for scalable data; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出机器人需要仿真以扩展数据，机器人应专精而非模仿人类。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030, with 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险；可解释性至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延迟超级智能的到来；需要透明度和国际合作。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet a huge opportunity; use Proven Better New to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；用“已验证、更优、全新”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Copying proven products is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：复制已验证产品是道德套利；起步应小而谦逊，而非宏大。

pincus.en: AI era: write markdown teaching LLMs to code, not code calling LLMs.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 时代：写教 LLM 写代码的 markdown，而非调用 LLM 的代码。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer better now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费应用因分发问题不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更佳。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域比选对船更重要。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source is crucial for safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源对安全至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source models are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not the openness itself.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源与闭源模型与安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，而非开放性本身。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加了奖励黑客和支线任务，使监控可靠性下降。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models are not necessarily accelerationist; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源模型不一定加速主义，可以同时支持开放性和有意的放缓。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives due to cost and flexibility, staying close to the frontier and driving enterprise adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终，开源 AI 因成本和灵活性而繁荣，接近前沿并推动企业采用。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs to US; AGI defined as economically profitable autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年：AI 推动美国就业回流；AGI 定义为智能体可无限自主运行且盈利；CEO 亲自使用 AI 是成功关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; human oversight essential; SaaS not dying; AI job apocalypse is false.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年：人人拥有智能体，但需人类监督；SaaS 未死；AI 失业末日论不成立。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年：AI 放大使用者心态；自动化反而创造更多人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; engineers need broad expertise, and demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要的工作负载；工程师需要广泛的专业知识，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems should be workload-specific; generic systems are inefficient, and specialized ones are crucial for agents.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统应针对特定工作负载定制；通用系统效率低，专用系统对智能体至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training; quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化正与训练融合；量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASICs; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 正变成 ASIC；推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩解决，而非权重更新，以避免推理不一致。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competitors.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型供应商，开源采用主要出于成本而非隐私考虑。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open source handles 90% enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型能处理 90%企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must become negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not token spend.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是企业首要关切，应降至可忽略的边际成本。对 Token 的执念将消退，应关注价值实现而非 Token 消耗。

arvindjain.en: Competition not a worry; even merged AI companies meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key startup challenges.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，竞争不足为虑，即使所有 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10%的企业需求。执行力和信任是初创企业的关键挑战。

arvindjain.en: Agents lack deep context; investing in context graphs crucial. Platforms absorb model provider risk; enterprises struggle to commit.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体缺乏资深员工的深层上下文，投资上下文图谱至关重要。平台吸收模型供应商风险，企业难以做出承诺。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data, allowing individual fingerprints.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型设计的重要性，认为设计师应追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据，并允许个人风格在产品中留下印记。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use AI for ideation and rapid prototyping, not production.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 回顾 Claude Design 的起源，主张设计师用 AI 进行构思和快速原型，而非直接用于生产。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being early is more valuable than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 认为随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为关键差异，早一步尝试比打磨更重要。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and provide rich context, while humans retain monopoly on design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 指出模型缺乏审美，设计师应要求大量选项并提供丰富上下文，人类仍垄断设计思维。

nateparrott.en: HTML is the only document type that matters; custom editors enable unique work and solve specific design problems.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 强调 HTML 作为唯一重要文档类型，自定义编辑器能创造独特作品并解决特定设计问题。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Benchmarks are bottleneck; need continuous evolution as models saturate and reward hacking grows.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：评估是瓶颈；随着模型饱和与奖励黑客增多，基准需持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练是主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意与情感特质。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; more firms should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年：向数十亿用户提供单一模型导致平庸声音；更多公司应训练自有模型以保持多样性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步长达 13-14 年，算法改进与规模扩张相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; untapped sources include video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data. Pre-training should interleave action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Jeff Dean 提出数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人和合成数据等来源尚未充分开发；预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute. Inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jeff Dean 指出大多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍；推理（inference）才是真正的瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可大幅降低延迟。

jeffdean.en: The scarce skill won't be coding but taste: choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jeff Dean 认为稀缺技能不再是编码，而是品味：选择将数百个智能体（agent）导向解决哪些问题。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本权利；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding assistants deliver real productivity gains; open-weight models are key for innovation and geopolitics.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流和编程助手带来实际生产力提升；开放权重模型对创新和地缘政治至关重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users, not jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者，而非取代工作。

andrewng.en: AI augments humans, not replaces; open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear narratives often serve corporate interests.
andrewng.zh: AI 增强而非取代人类；开放模型防止守门人控制；恐惧叙事常服务于企业利益。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年：数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年：数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年：用专门数据进行后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed; open-source models may be compromised.
awang.zh: 2025 年：AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口；开源模型可能被渗透。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents finally work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年：递归自我改进标志新范式；智能体终于可用；超级智能临近；未经安全验证的开源强大模型不安全。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；要为六个月后的模型而建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code and productivity soaring.
boris.zh: 编码几乎被解决；工程师变成构建者，AI 编写大部分代码，生产力飙升。

boris.en: Safety is paramount; releasing AI in the wild is key to studying and improving alignment.
boris.zh: 安全至上；在真实环境中发布 AI 是研究和改进对齐的关键。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; AI becomes proactive, autonomous, and collaborative.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；AI 变得主动、自主和协作。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; empirical iteration beats upfront design.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型，少指令更佳；经验迭代优于预先设计。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 不会变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md, to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具，利用截图和 design.md，以避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready, ship at 80% complete, and iterate based on real feedback; perfectionism is fear.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，以 80% 完成度发布，并根据真实反馈迭代；完美主义是恐惧。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients, model success, and avoid venture capital traps.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高价值客户解决一个痛点问题，模仿成功模式，避免风险投资的陷阱。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase for most Google products; coding agents are most mature, and narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Agentic AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and user engagement, not cannibalistic; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Agentic AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和而非零和；成功指标应是客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not that hard to compete with model labs; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity; deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年软件创作将基本解决，带来更多机会；对代码的深入理解仍至关重要。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them; engineers shift from coding to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而会增加；工程师角色从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox: AI boosts software demand, so engineers remain essential, though roles evolve.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 提升软件需求，工程师依然关键，但角色演变。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，挑战了更好模型必然更贵的观念。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，采用轻量级通用工具。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

jensen.en: AI computing enters hyper Moore's law era; data centers become token factories.
jensen.zh: AI 计算进入超摩尔定律时代，数据中心成为智能代工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律出现：预训练、后训练和推理时思考。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not sudden superintelligence; safety is engineering.
jensen.zh: AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能；安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each 100x compute.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求百倍增长。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed.
jensen.zh: AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员需求更大。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; two of three leading frontier models no longer use it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性正在下降，尤其是在推理方面；三个领先前沿模型中有两个不再使用它。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，引发对芯片、内存和数据中心的争夺。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒 token 数——现已成为 AI 生产力的主导指标。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution, but fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅汽车。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments; diverse data accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，指出 Transformer 实现跨车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型，多样数据加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，认为物理 AI 经济影响大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，指出世界模型从物理仿真演进到神经仿真，实现物理 AI 高效训练。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, as AI surpasses human diagnostic accuracy.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，因为 AI 超越了人类的诊断准确性。

derya.en: Aging is measurable via phenotypic markers, not just epigenetic clocks, enabling practical interventions.
derya.zh: 衰老可通过表型标记测量，而不仅仅是表观遗传时钟，从而实现实际干预。

derya.en: Brain interfaces will merge humans with AI, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone.
derya.zh: 脑接口将人类与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非后装；RLHF 可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; new abilities emerge spiky, so harnesses must evolve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，因此工具必须不断演进。

thariq.en: RAG is anti-pattern for context; graph-based search preferred; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索中成为反模式，图搜索更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令和更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束阻碍性能；给出理由优于绝对禁止。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; value in wrapped apps and creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于封装应用和创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow, requires workflow redesign.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，如互联网/电力；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢，需重构工作流。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale; liquid nets suit edge devices.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出缩放定律下大规模非结构化 Transformer 占优，液态网络适合边缘设备。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，防止监管被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise sovereignty; small models enable private on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放权重模型赋能企业主权，小模型实现私有端侧 AI。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real gains need weight changes and compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，承认递归自我改进真实但早期，真正突破需权重变化和算力。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience inspiration are key; safety must start early.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习和神经科学启发是关键；安全研究必须尽早开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; combining large models with planning and search is key.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在十年内实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；将大模型与规划搜索结合是关键。

demis.en: Natural systems are efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds but new breakthroughs may be needed.
demis.zh: 自然系统可高效学习；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍有效，但可能需要新突破。

demis.en: Both scaling and innovation needed; world models crucial; AGI 5-10 years away; safety requires government regulation.
demis.zh: 缩放与创新并重；世界模型至关重要；AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全需要政府监管。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning and memory; current systems lack consistency; commercial pressure accelerates deployment, but ideal path would be slower.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；当前系统缺乏一致性；商业压力加速部署，但理想路径应更慢。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 进展并未加速，我们与超人 AI 的距离和 1970 年代一样远。

schmidhuber.en: Transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior for scaling.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他批评 Transformer 的二次复杂度浪费算力，线性变体在 Scaling 上更优。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇而保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity, not just next-token prediction.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他展望未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据，而非仅靠下一个词预测。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must internalize evolving context into weights, not just externalize via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须将不断演化的上下文内化到权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从纯 Scaling（规模扩张）的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression will replace RAG for holistic knowledge queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿 token；基于训练的压缩将取代 RAG，用于整体性知识查询。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with model routing combined with a trusted sidekick.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，模型路由与可信赖的“伙伴”模型相结合。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐超级模型很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; alignment requires non-commercial focus.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调 Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；对齐需要非商业专注。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; computing's future is glasses keeping people grounded in reality.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年初，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，并认为计算的未来是让用户扎根于现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; build platform not feature; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他提出最大化学习速率、善良促进创意文化、构建平台而非功能、早期套现以降低风险等观点。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality reduces social pressure; AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content valued more.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他重申阅后即焚降低社交压力，AR 将计算融入现实，AI 加速原型制作但真实内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesive experience.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月下旬，他强调分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件非护城河，生态和硬件更难复制，设计师是产品体验的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人是长期成功关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be more human; social media optimize for connection not competition; resilience key.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，社交媒体应优化连接而非竞争，韧性是创始人成功关键。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，恰逢人口下降之际出现；工作不会消失，但任务会流失；超级赋能个体将崛起；生产力提升带来经济繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; learnable skills.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体时代，品牌即个人；真实至关重要；创始人应直接讲述自己的故事；旧媒体偏防御，新媒体偏进攻；这些技能可以习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combination; optimism vs doom.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人技术兴起；AI 医疗优于多数医生但受监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治与冒险精神的黄金组合；乐观优于悲观。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups internationalize early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 存在安全风险。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出设计正成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust is built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 工具若缺乏人类引导会产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性和价值创造来建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望与模型交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币有隐藏风险，并认为冥想应颠覆你的现有生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software dying; moat in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 是杠杆工具，纯软件正在消亡，护城河在于硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human desire irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类欲望不可替代。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是测试场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，且仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 临近。

brockman.en: Compute bottleneck persists; agents high autonomy; prompt engineering evolves; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，算力瓶颈持续，智能体高自主，提示工程演变，安全靠迭代部署。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每天 1%的改进会带来每年 3700%的增长，AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, not just answering questions, and highlighted token value per user as the key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题，并强调每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed orchestration across models, tools, and devices as key to long-term value, and that the model is not the product.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调跨模型、工具和设备的编排是长期价值的关键，模型本身不是产品。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently championed curiosity, deep learning over credentials, and building products with obsession, while warning against commoditization and centralized control.
aravind.zh: 他始终倡导好奇心、深度学习而非学历，以及以痴迷心态打造产品，同时警惕商品化和集中控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编码构建 GUI 反直觉但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不擅长，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程被转化而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling yields superhuman reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and time bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调推理时算力的 Scaling 带来超人类推理，但收益递减且受时间瓶颈限制。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑算力因素。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in general domains; cooperation and negotiation are key.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他认为自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在通用领域失效，合作与协商是关键。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is a key challenge as AI proofs become too complex for human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明变得过于复杂，可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制而永生，AI 智能体会追求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，数字 AI 永生，AI 会装傻，国际合作可能但美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation is steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; education and healthcare will transform.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体会产生自我保存子目标，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，AI 将取代工作并变革教育和医疗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; AI doctors more empathetic; need intelligent design of AI beings.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 能力是锯齿状的而非全面 AGI（通用人工智能），AI 医生更富同理心，需智能设计 AI 生命。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior due to instant knowledge sharing; alignment research priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越，对齐研究应优先，AI 应被训练得如母亲般关怀。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't yield AGI; specialized agents and mixed reality are future.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI；未来是专业智能体和混合现实。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding improves reasoning; energy is a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：Llama 3 展现快速 Scaling；编码提升推理；能源成瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for connection; open platforms can beat closed; holographic presence is ultimate social experience.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：Meta 是连接的技术公司；开放平台可胜封闭；全息临场是终极社交体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; glasses blend physical and digital; AI frees time for creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 赋予人人超级智能；人很聪明；眼镜融合虚实；AI 解放时间用于创造。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source models crucial; physical infrastructure bottleneck; AI increases demand for human work; personalization key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：开源模型关键；物理基础设施瓶颈；AI 增加人力需求；个性化重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science; interpretability reveals biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 将生物学转为工程；分层世界模型；开源加速科学；可解释性揭示生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; AI empowers individuals; distributed AI safer; hardware slow; fashion first.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：眼镜是下一平台；AI 赋能个人；分布式 AI 更安全；硬件慢；时尚优先。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck; human-AI collaboration essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈；人机协作至关重要。

markchen.en: Pre-training not dead; RL excels in objective domains; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：预训练未死；强化学习擅长客观领域；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025→26：自动化科学研究是最大更新；1 年内实现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers are critical; OpenAI creates stars, not just hires them.
markchen.zh: 始终：人才密度和保护顶尖研究者至关重要；OpenAI 培养明星而非仅招聘。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; need better world models and active agents; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决根本问题；需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; active learning is essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is dangerous; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是危险的；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI 和全球协调。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train as honest Bayesian predictor, avoid RL, use non-agentic guardrails for mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习，用非智能体护栏提供数学安全保证。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents need new languages prioritizing verifiability over human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编程智能体需要新语言，优先可验证性而非人类易用性。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as key as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop, enabling new use cases.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors thrive in applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗非价值；应用 AI 领域专业厂商崛起。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，AI 让小团队也能规模化；应面向未来模型能力构建，而非受限于当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，智能体原生设计与尽早发布至关重要；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; verification loops and model pushback are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 证明长周期任务委派可行；验证循环与模型反驳是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性；token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets are key.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；高质量精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模改进，而非单一突破；专门架构胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AI tools narrow hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient; they don't replace scientists.
jumper.zh: AI 工具缩小假设空间，提高实验效率，但不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Understanding is not achieved by the model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 模型并未实现理解，它提供预测和控制，理解仍留待人类完成。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, code as truth, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，代码为真相，组织扁平化。

fiona.en: Coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers dogfood; JIT planning persists.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调编码天花板被抬高，高能动性与高问责并重；验证框架至关重要；管理者亲自使用产品；即时规划延续。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我强调机器学习可归结为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并指出正确划分训练、验证、测试集对评估至关重要。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，而安全的核心在于模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我主张安全需要显式训练与多层防护，更大模型不会自动更安全，智能体必须配备护栏与沙箱。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; interpretability may become real via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AI 具有异类漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类，而智能体可能让可解释性成为真正的科学。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从用户意图生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和专业知识变得更加珍贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专业知识，他们常误用 AI，威胁人才管道。

ethanhe.en: AI can enhance thinking via personalized tutoring; policy may protect some professions even if AI is superior.
ethanhe.zh: AI 可通过个性化辅导增强思考；即使 AI 更优，政策也可能保护某些职业。

ivyross.en: Design should focus on unarticulated needs, balancing data with intuition; technology should blend into home environments.
ivyross.zh: 设计应关注未言明的需求，平衡数据与直觉；技术应无缝融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是会思考的感觉生物；技术应增强我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for creativity; future work combines human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件；未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment is not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不保证涌现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point; safety via RSP.
dario.zh: 2024 年：后训练和可解释性成为关键；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点；通过负责任扩展策略保障安全。

dario.en: AI progress exponential; misuse risk grows; open-source is red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 进展呈指数级；滥用风险上升；开源是伪命题；企业级聚焦与安全一致。

dario.en: Exponential nearing end; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic disruption and inequality; interpretability crucial.
dario.zh: 2026 年：指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内到来；经济破坏与不平等；可解释性至关重要。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities intertwined; scaling laws hold; enterprise focus; human oversight; interpretability for control.
dario.zh: 始终：安全与能力交织；缩放定律成立；企业级聚焦；人类监督；可解释性用于控制。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters; they spark breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节间拥抱无聊与休息，能激发如 Nest 般的突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; products are painkillers, not vitamins.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；产品是止痛药，而非维生素。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated; smartphone remains best form, displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将联邦化；智能手机仍是最佳形态，显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对理解语言和常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，LeCun 称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息，世界模型通过观察学习。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential; open source crucial.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，LeCun 认为自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能，JEPA 和世界模型是关键，开源平台对多样性至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable reasoning and planning; open-source accelerates innovation.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，LeCun 指出 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现推理和规划，开源加速创新，未来 AI 非生成式。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the future.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，LeCun 明确 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型在抽象表示空间预测，分层规划是未来，开源和机器人时代来临。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; AI companions should push back, not be sycophantic.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；关注遏制与对齐；AI 伴侣应适度反驳而非一味迎合。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; containment must come first; AI cost drops 90% in 2 years; no race to AGI.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；遏制优先；AI 成本两年降 90%；AGI 竞赛不存在。

suleyman.en: White-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months, not jobs; models are not conscious; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化，而非整个岗位；模型没有意识；微软必须拥有自己的前沿模型。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; outcome-based pricing preferred until outcomes achieved.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；在成果实现前，人们偏好基于结果的定价。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists see max returns; build agentic systems for Azure networking.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才回报最大；为 Azure 网络构建智能体式系统。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; deploying GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律早期并不明显，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。

murati.en: Iterative deployment with public feedback is essential for safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈对安全和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从基于回合的交互转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时协作。

murati.en: Focus on institutional design and transparency over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为 AI 治理应更关注制度设计和透明度，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop to align intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 她始终认为，随着 AI 发展，保持人类参与以对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调形式化验证是为了扩展才华，而不仅是消除错误，它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他指出即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; strong opinions loosely held, change when data says no.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调容错界面是机器学习产品的关键，并主张“有主见但保持开放”，数据否定时果断改变。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他提出没有唯一正确的组织模式，应选择适合个人特质的模式，长期任职能建立信任与效率。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement; AI gives users control.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他将战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，并认为 AI 赋予用户控制权。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables plain-English interaction; being first to adopt change is key during tech shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 支持自然语言交互，在技术变革期率先采用是关键。

mensch.en: Data quality, not just compute, drives model performance; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量而非单纯算力驱动模型性能，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as critical as scaling; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升和数据质量与规模扩张同等重要，价值转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI is not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制和垂直专业化；AGI 非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需建独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用受组织变革制约。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约是表达产品本质，而非仅仅去除冗余。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; joy and humor essential; care in products shows gratitude.
jonyive.zh: 创新是向前推进，而非为破坏而破坏；愉悦和幽默不可或缺；用心制作产品是对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari EV redefines brand via innovation; authenticity in UX; performance multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车通过创新重新定义品牌；用户体验要真实；性能是多维的。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分收益；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域表现出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 开源模型因主权原因而持续存在；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should run locally with user tools; shared platforms remain vital; execution beats specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应在本地运行并拥有用户工具；共享平台仍重要；执行优于规格。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；聚焦能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Main gap is user mindset: any problem can be given to AI; kids excel naturally.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距是用户心态：任何问题都可交给 AI；孩子天然擅长。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; async interaction ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，Opus 处理开放问题；异步交互理想。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors; hardware projects accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误；硬件项目易上手。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使低精度更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的缩放轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithms; post-training with RLVR enables reasoning and tool use, matching frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法更重要；后训练结合 RLVR 实现推理和工具使用，媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: Hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; pure reasoning models like O3 could dominate; open models win on personalization.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，混合推理模型可能是暂时的；纯推理模型如 O3 可能主导；开放模型在个性化上胜出。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in execution, but US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；中国实验室擅长执行，但中美差距可能扩大。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉、从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建和交付，愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应成为块状通才，招聘不受旧流程束缚的新锐毕业生而非资深人士。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and ambiguity tolerance define designer value.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，强调仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威性和对模糊性的容忍才是设计师的价值所在。

jennywen.en: Adopt AI tools after six months; speed and hype are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，建议延迟六个月采用 AI 工具，速度和流行度不应成为设计理由。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）可涌现新能力；视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：合成数据是未来但需保持熵；人形机器人可从汽车领域迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; keep AI on leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：软件 3.0 以提示为程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；需谨慎控制 AI。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练如粗糙进化；强化学习需改进信用分配。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill, not typing; agent-first tools.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：我将所有编码委托给智能体；瓶颈是指挥技能而非打字；工具应智能体优先。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 仅用摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling a generalizable driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题；扩展通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 跨 500 多个城市的零样本泛化是可能的；短期内消费车辆将超过机器人出租车。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合并提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; from curiosity-driven exploration to leveraging all data sources for a universal robot brain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，观点从好奇心驱动探索演变为将机器人视为数据问题，利用所有数据源构建通用机器人大脑。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出通用机器人大脑（类似语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任意形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it requires rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人学的主要挑战，需要严格测试，不能像软件那样规模化。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe for robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出在多样化数据上预训练并在真实世界数据上后训练是机器人学习的关键配方。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，迭代部署有助于在实践中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; measuring capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展，同时指出能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，提出持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，并认为仅靠强化学习即可。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，强调思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，并主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保持其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，指出长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化，且模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年或更久；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress should be measured through deep human evaluations.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展应通过深度人工评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AI models will become increasingly differentiated based on the values and objective functions of the labs that create them.
edwinchen.zh: AI 模型将因创造它们的实验室的价值观和目标函数而日益分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根本性问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and games enable AI to surpass human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终，他坚持在可验证领域（如代码、游戏）中，AI 能超越人类知识。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand through consistent execution and start with simpler products to prove yourself.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；通过一致的执行来建立品牌，并从更简单的产品开始证明自己。

carlpei.en: Future phones rely on generative UI and proactive agents; hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 未来手机依赖生成式界面和主动式智能体；硬件利润率低，因此必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI for consumers, using context and trust, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；专注于面向消费者的应用型 AI，利用上下文和信任，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; AI is an ingredient, not a feature; marketing arbitrage is key.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟市场中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非功能；营销套利至关重要。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能取代；应用将消失。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型要有严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前途的路径。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education.
nando.zh: 非洲可以在 AI 领域跨越遗留问题；语言模型可以革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; solutions remain open.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署始终是最大挑战；解决方案仍待探索。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills complement coding.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要；人类技能与编程互补。

nando.en: Emphasis shifted from universal algorithms to practical applications and regional leapfrogging.
nando.zh: 关注点从通用算法转向实际应用与区域跨越式发展。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; RL is a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，强化学习只是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据是主要瓶颈，模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是规模化学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to robot foundation models; physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，强调简单端到端模型利用多样数据是关键，物理图灵测试是具身智能的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one (low-level control) remains hardest part of embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测智能机器人数量 2040 年超过 iPhone，系统一（底层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难部分。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似于梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步的主要指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) dramatically expands achievements.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展了成就。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; managing agent teams and compute supply are now the key bottlenecks.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为存在能力过剩；管理智能体团队和算力供应成为关键瓶颈。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和聚焦问题来推动工作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt; pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: AI is a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 是创意伙伴，应开放地与其协作，避免僵化结构。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 通才型人才，能端到端执行并利用 AI 补足短板，最具价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测进展，测试时算力可能超越预训练缩放成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language not primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，坚持自然语言不是主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design more valuable.
